reason: I live in one editor and Cursor/Copilot already share context inside it. I'm not juggling enough agents across tools to justify installing another daemon, and I don't buy dev tools without checking Reddit and GitHub issues first — this is too new with no track record.
objection: Cursor/Copilot already do context sharing within my own editor, so Loom feels like a solution looking for a problem unless I'm running multiple agents across tools.
would_change_my_mind: Independent reviews showing a real cross-agent context problem my editor can't solve, plus a free trial so I can test it without committing.
